AddDcdnDomain.description_en: To add a domain name, call the AddDcdnDomain operation

AddDcdnIpaDomain.description_en: Call the AddDcdnIpaDomain operation to add a domain name for IP Application Accelerator (IPA). You can add only one accelerated domain name at a time
AddDcdnIpaDomain.description_zh: 调用AddDcdnIpaDomain添加IPA层应用加速域名，一次只能提交一个加速域名

BatchAddDcdnDomain.description_en: Call `BatchAddDcdnDomain` to add multiple domain names

BatchCreateDcdnWafRules.description_en: Call the BatchCreateDcdnWafRules operation to set WAF mitigation rules

BatchDeleteDcdnDomainConfigs.description_en: Call BatchDeleteDcdnDomainConfigs to delete configurations for multiple domain names at once
BatchDeleteDcdnDomainConfigs.description_zh: 调用BatchDeleteDcdnDomainConfigs批量删除域名配置

BatchDeleteDcdnKv.description_en: Deletes a batch of key-value pairs from a specified KV namespace
BatchDeleteDcdnKv.description_zh: 根据指定的键名列表来批量删除指定KV存储空间的键值对

BatchDeleteDcdnKvWithHighCapacity.description_en: Deletes multiple key-value pairs from a specified KV namespace based on a list of keys. The maximum size of the request body is 100 MB
BatchDeleteDcdnKvWithHighCapacity.description_zh: 根据指定的键名列表批量删除指定KV存储空间下的键值对，最大允许上传100M的请求体

BatchDeleteDcdnWafRules.description_en: Call BatchDeleteDcdnWafRules to delete WAF rules in a batch
BatchDeleteDcdnWafRules.description_zh: 调用BatchDeleteDcdnWafRules批量删除WAF防护规则

BatchModifyDcdnWafRules.description_en: You can call BatchModifyDcdnWafRules to modify WAF mitigation rules in a batch. This operation supports modifying configurations only in the bot management scenario
BatchModifyDcdnWafRules.description_zh: 调用BatchModifyDcdnWafRules批量修改WAF防护规则，目前仅支持修改配置Bot管理防护场景

BatchPutDcdnKv.description_en: Adds or updates multiple key-value (KV) pairs in a specified namespace

BatchPutDcdnKvWithHighCapacity.description_en: Sets multiple key-value pairs for a specified KV namespace. The request body can be up to 100 MB
BatchPutDcdnKvWithHighCapacity.description_zh: 根据指定的键名列表来批量设置指定KV存储空间的键值对，请求体最大支持100M

BatchSetDcdnDomainConfigs.description_en: `BatchSetDcdnDomainConfigs` configures multiple domain names at once
BatchSetDcdnDomainConfigs.description_zh: 调用BatchSetDcdnDomainConfigs实现域名批量配置功能

BatchSetDcdnIpaDomainConfigs.description_en: Configures IP Application Acceleration (IPA) for multiple domain names in a single operation
BatchSetDcdnIpaDomainConfigs.description_zh: 调用BatchSetDcdnIpaDomainConfigs批量配置IPA层应用加速域名

BatchSetDcdnWafDomainConfigs.description_en: Call BatchSetDcdnWafDomainConfigs to set the protection status for multiple domain names in a batch
BatchSetDcdnWafDomainConfigs.description_zh: 调用BatchSetDcdnWafDomainConfigs批量设置域名防护状态

BatchStartDcdnDomain.description_en: Enables multiple disabled accelerated domain names in a batch. This operation changes the DomainStatus to online
BatchStartDcdnDomain.description_zh: 批量启用状态为停用的加速域名，将DomainStatus变更为online

BatchStopDcdnDomain.description_en: Disables one or more accelerated domain names and changes their status to offline
BatchStopDcdnDomain.description_zh: 停用加速域名，将DomainStatus变更为offline

CheckDcdnProjectExist.description_en: Checks whether a real-time log delivery project exists
CheckDcdnProjectExist.description_zh: 调用CheckDcdnProjectExist检查实时日志项目是否存在

CommitStagingRoutineCode.description_en: You can call the CommitStagingRoutineCode operation to promote a staging version of your JavaScript (JS) code to the production environment
CommitStagingRoutineCode.description_zh: 调用CommitStagingRoutineCode把测试版本unstable的JS代码生成供线上Env环境使用的正式版本

CreateDcdnCertificateSigningRequest.description_en: You can call CreateDcdnCertificateSigningRequest to create a Certificate Signing Request (CSR) file
CreateDcdnCertificateSigningRequest.description_zh: 调用CreateDcdnCertificateSigningRequest创建 CSR（证书签名请求）文件

CreateDcdnDeliverTask.description_en: Call CreateDcdnDeliverTask to create a report tracking task. After you subscribe, the system periodically sends statistical reports to you by email
CreateDcdnDeliverTask.description_zh: 调用CreateDcdnDeliverTask创建报表订阅任务，订阅成功后系统会周期性地以邮件方式向您发送报表统计数据

CreateDcdnSLSRealTimeLogDelivery.description_en: Creates a real-time log delivery project

CreateDcdnSubTask.description_en: You can call the CreateDcdnSubTask operation to customize operations reports

CreateDcdnWafGroup.description_en: The CreateDcdnWafGroup operation creates a custom WAF rule group
CreateDcdnWafGroup.description_zh: 调用CreateDcdnWafGroup创建自定义WAF规则组

CreateDcdnWafPolicy.description_en: Invokes CreateDcdnWafPolicy to set WAF mitigation policies

CreateRoutine.description_zh: 调用CreateRoutine创建一个边缘函数（Routine）

CreateSlrAndSlsProject.description_en: Creates a service-linked role (SLR) and a Log Service project
CreateSlrAndSlsProject.description_zh: 调用CreateSlrAndSlsProject创建服务关联角色（SLR）以及日志服务（SLS）项目

DeleteDcdnDeliverTask.description_en: Deletes a subscribed report task by its task ID
DeleteDcdnDeliverTask.description_zh: 调用DeleteDcdnDeliverTask根据任务ID删除已订阅的报表任务

DeleteDcdnDomain.description_zh: 调用DeleteDcdnDomain删除已添加的加速域名

DeleteDcdnIpaDomain.description_en: You can call the DeleteDcdnIpaDomain operation to delete an accelerated domain name for IP Application Accelerator (IPA)
DeleteDcdnIpaDomain.description_zh: 调用DeleteDcdnIpaDomain删除已添加的IPA层加速域名

DeleteDcdnIpaSpecificConfig.description_en: You can call the DeleteDcdnIpaSpecificConfig operation to delete the IP Application Accelerator (IPA) layer configuration for a specified domain name
DeleteDcdnIpaSpecificConfig.description_zh: 调用DeleteDcdnIpaSpecificConfig删除指定域名的IPA层配置

DeleteDcdnKv.description_en: EdgeKV provides a global key-value (KV) database on Dynamic Content Delivery Network (DCDN) edge nodes. You can call the DeleteDcdnKv operation to delete a KV pair from a namespace
DeleteDcdnKv.description_zh: EdgeKv产品在全站加速边缘节点提供一个全球通用的KV（Key-Value）数据库，调用DeleteDcdnKv删除Namespace的Key-Value（KV）对

DeleteDcdnKvNamespace.description_en: Deletes a specified namespace from your account

DeleteDcdnRealTimeLogProject.description_en: Deletes real-time logs of a log delivery project
DeleteDcdnRealTimeLogProject.description_zh: 调用DeleteDcdnRealTimeLogProject删除整个项目的实时日志

DeleteDcdnSpecificConfig.description_en: Deletes a specific configuration for a domain name
DeleteDcdnSpecificConfig.description_zh: 调用DeleteDcdnSpecificConfig删除域名的指定配置

DeleteDcdnSpecificStagingConfig.description_en: Deletes one or more staging (grayscale) configurations for an accelerated domain name
DeleteDcdnSpecificStagingConfig.description_zh: 调用DeleteDcdnSpecificStagingConfig删除加速域名的配置（灰度）

DeleteDcdnSubTask.description_en: You can call the DeleteDcdnSubTask operation to delete all customized operations reports
DeleteDcdnSubTask.description_zh: 调用DeleteDcdnSubTask删除所有已定制的运营报表

DeleteDcdnUserConfig.description_zh: 调用DeleteDcdnUserConfig删除用户维度的功能配置

DeleteDcdnWafGroup.description_en: You can call the DeleteDcdnWafGroup operation to delete a custom WAF rule group
DeleteDcdnWafGroup.description_zh: 调用DeleteDcdnWafGroup删除自定义WAF规则组

DeleteDcdnWafPolicy.description_zh: 调用DeleteDcdnWafPolicy删除指定防护策略

DeleteRoutine.description_en: Deletes the configuration for an Edge Routine function
DeleteRoutine.description_zh: 调用DeleteRoutine删除边缘函数（EdgeRoutine）的函数（Routine）配置

DeleteRoutineCodeRevision.description_en: Deletes a specific code revision of an Edge Routine
DeleteRoutineCodeRevision.description_zh: 调用DeleteRoutineCodeRevision删除边缘函数指定版本的代码

DeleteRoutineConfEnvs.description_en: Deletes custom grayscale environments from the environment list of an Edge Routine
DeleteRoutineConfEnvs.description_zh: 调用DeleteRoutineConfEnvs删除边缘函数Env列表中的自定义灰度环境

DescribeDcdnAclFields.description_en: You can call the DescribeDcdnAclFields operation to query the fields that are available for access control rules
DescribeDcdnAclFields.description_zh: 调用DescribeDcdnAclFields为访问控制配置界面提供规则限制项

DescribeDcdnBgpBpsData.description_en: Call the DescribeDcdnBgpBpsData operation to query bandwidth data for Border Gateway Protocol (BGP) acceleration at a 5-minute granularity
DescribeDcdnBgpBpsData.description_zh: 调用DescribeDcdnBgpBpsData查询BGP加速五分钟粒度带宽数据

DescribeDcdnBgpTrafficData.description_en: Call the DescribeDcdnBgpTrafficData operation to query Border Gateway Protocol (BGP) acceleration traffic data at a five-minute granularity
DescribeDcdnBgpTrafficData.description_zh: 调用DescribeDcdnBgpTrafficData查询BGP加速五分钟粒度流量数据

DescribeDcdnBlockedRegions.description_en: Queries the countries and regions supported by the Location Blacklist feature
DescribeDcdnBlockedRegions.description_zh: 调用DescribeDcdnBlockedRegions查询区域封禁支持的国家和地区

DescribeDcdnCertificateDetail.description_en: You can call the DescribeDcdnCertificateDetail operation to query the details of a DCDN certificate

DescribeDcdnCertificateList.description_en: Queries a list of certificates by domain name
DescribeDcdnCertificateList.description_zh: 调用DescribeDcdnCertificateList按照域名查询证书列表信息

DescribeDcdnDdosService.description_en: Queries the status of the DCDN DDoS service
DescribeDcdnDdosService.description_zh: 调用DescribeDcdnDdosService查询DCDN DDoS服务状态

DescribeDcdnDdosSpecInfo.description_en: Queries the edition specifications for Anti-DDoS for DCDN
DescribeDcdnDdosSpecInfo.description_zh: 调用DescribeDcdnDdosSpecInfo查询DCDN DDoS用户版本规格

DescribeDcdnDeletedDomains.description_en: Queries the domain names that have been deleted from your account
DescribeDcdnDeletedDomains.description_zh: 调用DescribeDcdnDeletedDomains查询您名下已删除的域名

DescribeDcdnDeliverList.description_en: Call the DescribeDcdnDeliverList operation to query a list of all report tracking tasks
DescribeDcdnDeliverList.description_zh: 调用DescribeDcdnDeliverList查询报表订阅任务列表，系统将返回所有的订阅任务列表

DescribeDcdnDomainBpsData.description_en: Call DescribeDcdnDomainBpsData to query network bandwidth monitoring data for accelerated domain names
DescribeDcdnDomainBpsData.description_zh: 调用DescribeDcdnDomainBpsData查询加速域名的网络带宽监控数据

DescribeDcdnDomainBpsDataByLayer.description_en: Call the DescribeDcdnDomainBpsDataByLayer operation to query bandwidth data by protocol
DescribeDcdnDomainBpsDataByLayer.description_zh: 调用DescribeDcdnDomainBpsDataByLayer按协议分类获取带宽数据

DescribeDcdnDomainByCertificate.description_en: Call the DescribeDcdnDomainByCertificate operation to query domain names based on certificate information
DescribeDcdnDomainByCertificate.description_zh: 调用DescribeDcdnDomainByCertificate根据证书信息查询域名

DescribeDcdnDomainCcActivityLog.description_en: Call DescribeDcdnDomainCcActivityLog to query logs of requests blocked by CC protection rules
DescribeDcdnDomainCcActivityLog.description_zh: 调用DescribeDcdnDomainCcActivityLog查询频次控制规则拦截日志

DescribeDcdnDomainCertificateInfo.description_en: Call the DescribeDcdnDomainCertificateInfo operation to query the certificate information for a specified domain name
DescribeDcdnDomainCertificateInfo.description_zh: 调用DescribeDcdnDomainCertificateInfo查询指定域名证书信息

DescribeDcdnDomainCname.description_en: Checks the CNAME resolution of accelerated domain names to determine whether CNAME configuration is complete
DescribeDcdnDomainCname.description_zh: 调用DescribeDcdnDomainCname对加速域名CNAME进行解析检测，查看解析结果判断是否完成CNAME配置

DescribeDcdnDomainConfigs.description_en: Call DescribeDcdnDomainConfigs to get the configurations of an accelerated domain name
DescribeDcdnDomainConfigs.description_zh: 调用DescribeDcdnDomainConfigs获取加速域名的配置信息

DescribeDcdnDomainDetail.description_en: Queries the basic configuration information of a specified accelerated domain name by calling DescribeDcdnDomainDetail
DescribeDcdnDomainDetail.description_zh: 调用DescribeDcdnDomainDetail获取指定加速域名配置的基本信息

DescribeDcdnDomainHitRateData.description_en: Call DescribeDcdnDomainHitRateData to query the byte hit ratio of one or more domain names
DescribeDcdnDomainHitRateData.description_zh: 调用DescribeDcdnDomainHitRateData查询域名的字节命中率（命中字节百分比）

DescribeDcdnDomainHttpCodeData.description_en: Call DescribeDcdnDomainHttpCodeData to query the total number and proportions of HTTP return codes for accelerated domain names
DescribeDcdnDomainHttpCodeData.description_zh: 调用DescribeDcdnDomainHttpCodeData获取加速域名的HTTP返回码总数和占比数据

DescribeDcdnDomainHttpCodeDataByLayer.description_en: Call the DescribeDcdnDomainHttpCodeDataByLayer operation to obtain HTTP status code data classified by protocol
DescribeDcdnDomainHttpCodeDataByLayer.description_zh: 调用DescribeDcdnDomainHttpCodeDataByLayer按协议分类获取HTTP状态码数据

DescribeDcdnDomainIpaBpsData.description_en: Call DescribeDcdnDomainIpaBpsData to query network bandwidth monitoring data for Layer 4 acceleration of accelerated domain names. You can query data from the last 90 days
DescribeDcdnDomainIpaBpsData.description_zh: 调用DescribeDcdnDomainIpaBpsData获取加速域名四层加速的网络带宽监控数据，支持获取最近90天的数据

DescribeDcdnDomainIpaConnData.description_en: Call the DescribeDcdnDomainIpaConnData operation to query the number of connections for IP Application Accelerator (IPA)

DescribeDcdnDomainIpaTrafficData.description_en: Call DescribeDcdnDomainIpaTrafficData to query Layer 4 traffic monitoring data for accelerated domain names. You can query data from the last 90 days
DescribeDcdnDomainIpaTrafficData.description_zh: 调用DescribeDcdnDomainIpaTrafficData获取加速域名的四层加速网络流量监控数据，支持获取最近90天的数据

DescribeDcdnDomainIspData.description_en: Call DescribeDcdnDomainIspData to query daily statistics on carrier distribution for an accelerated domain name. You can query data from the last 90 days
DescribeDcdnDomainIspData.description_zh: 调用DescribeDcdnDomainIspData查询加速域名天粒度的用户运营商分布数据统计，支持获取最近90天的数据

DescribeDcdnDomainLog.description_en: Call the DescribeDcdnDomainLog operation to query the download URLs of raw access logs for a specified domain name
DescribeDcdnDomainLog.description_zh: 调用DescribeDcdnDomainLog查询指定域名的原始访问日志的下载地址

DescribeDcdnDomainMultiUsageData.description_en: Calls the DescribeDcdnDomainMultiUsageData operation to query the billing data for various metrics of one or more DCDN accelerated domain names. The minimum data granularity is 5 minutes. This operation does not return data for billing items that are not request-based
DescribeDcdnDomainMultiUsageData.description_zh: 调用DescribeDcdnDomainMultiUsageData批量查询DCDN域名的各计量口径计费数据（最小粒度为5分钟）， 不包含非请求类的计费项

DescribeDcdnDomainOriginBpsData.description_zh: 调用DescribeDcdnDomainOriginBpsData查询域名的回源带宽监控数据

DescribeDcdnDomainOriginTrafficData.description_en: Call DescribeDcdnDomainOriginTrafficData to query monitoring data about back-to-origin traffic for domain names
DescribeDcdnDomainOriginTrafficData.description_zh: 调用DescribeDcdnDomainOriginTrafficData查询域名的回源流量监控数据

DescribeDcdnDomainProperty.description_en: Call the DescribeDcdnDomainProperty operation to query the protocol type of an IP Application Accelerator (IPA) domain name

DescribeDcdnDomainPvData.description_en: Call DescribeDcdnDomainPvData to query page view (PV) statistics for a domain name at a minimum granularity of one hour
DescribeDcdnDomainPvData.description_zh: 调用DescribeDcdnDomainPvData查询域名最小1小时粒度的PV页面访问统计

DescribeDcdnDomainQpsData.description_en: You can call the DescribeDcdnDomainQpsData operation to query the queries per second (QPS) for a domain name
DescribeDcdnDomainQpsData.description_zh: 调用DescribeDcdnDomainQpsData查询域名的每秒访问次数QPS

DescribeDcdnDomainQpsDataByLayer.description_en: Call DescribeDcdnDomainQpsDataByLayer to query the queries per second (QPS) of an accelerated domain name by protocol
DescribeDcdnDomainQpsDataByLayer.description_zh: 调用DescribeDcdnDomainQpsDataByLayer按协议查询域名的每秒访问次数QPS

DescribeDcdnDomainRealTimeBpsData.description_en: Call the DescribeDcdnDomainRealTimeBpsData operation to query the real-time network bandwidth of a domain name
DescribeDcdnDomainRealTimeBpsData.description_zh: 调用DescribeDcdnDomainRealTimeBpsData查询域名实时网络带宽数据

DescribeDcdnDomainRealTimeByteHitRateDat.description_en: Call the DescribeDcdnDomainRealTimeByteHitRateData operation to query real-time byte hit ratio data for one or more domain names
DescribeDcdnDomainRealTimeByteHitRateDat.description_zh: 调用DescribeDcdnDomainRealTimeByteHitRateData查询域名实时字节命中率数据

DescribeDcdnDomainRealTimeHttpCodeData.description_en: Call the DescribeDcdnDomainRealTimeHttpCodeData operation to query the total number and proportions of real-time HTTP return codes for a domain name
DescribeDcdnDomainRealTimeHttpCodeData.description_zh: 调用DescribeDcdnDomainRealTimeHttpCodeData查询域名实时HTTP返回码总数和占比数据

DescribeDcdnDomainRealTimeQpsData.description_en: Call the DescribeDcdnDomainRealTimeQpsData operation to obtain the queries per second (QPS) data for an accelerated domain name
DescribeDcdnDomainRealTimeQpsData.description_zh: 调用DescribeDcdnDomainRealTimeQpsData获取域名每秒访问次数的数据

DescribeDcdnDomainRealTimeReqHitRateData.description_en: Call the DescribeDcdnDomainRealTimeReqHitRateData operation to query the real-time request hit rate of one or more accelerated domain names
DescribeDcdnDomainRealTimeReqHitRateData.description_zh: 调用DescribeDcdnDomainRealTimeReqHitRateData查询域名实时请求命中率数据

DescribeDcdnDomainRealTimeSrcBpsData.description_en: Call DescribeDcdnDomainRealTimeSrcBpsData to query the real-time back-to-origin bandwidth data for an accelerated domain name
DescribeDcdnDomainRealTimeSrcBpsData.description_zh: 调用DescribeDcdnDomainRealTimeSrcBpsData查询域名实时回源带宽数据

DescribeDcdnDomainRealTimeSrcHttpCodeDat.description_en: Call the DescribeDcdnDomainRealTimeSrcHttpCodeData operation to query real-time data on the proportions of origin-fetch HTTP return codes for an accelerated domain name
DescribeDcdnDomainRealTimeSrcHttpCodeDat.description_zh: 调用DescribeDcdnDomainRealTimeSrcHttpCodeData查询域名实时回源HTTP返回码占比数据

DescribeDcdnDomainRealTimeSrcTrafficData.description_en: Call the DescribeDcdnDomainRealTimeSrcTrafficData operation to query real-time back-to-origin traffic data for accelerated domain names
DescribeDcdnDomainRealTimeSrcTrafficData.description_zh: 调用DescribeDcdnDomainRealTimeSrcTrafficData查询域名实时回源流量监控数据

DescribeDcdnDomainRealTimeTrafficData.description_en: Call the DescribeDcdnDomainRealTimeTrafficData operation to query traffic monitoring data for an accelerated domain name over a time interval
DescribeDcdnDomainRealTimeTrafficData.description_zh: 调用DescribeDcdnDomainRealTimeTrafficData查询域名单位时间段的流量监控数据

DescribeDcdnDomainRegionData.description_zh: 调用DescribeDcdnDomainRegionData查询加速域名天粒度的用户区域分布数据统计，支持获取90天的数据

DescribeDcdnDomainTopReferVisit.description_en: Call the DescribeDcdnDomainTopReferVisit operation to query the top referrers for a domain name by the number of visits. You can query data from the last 90 days
DescribeDcdnDomainTopReferVisit.description_zh: 调用DescribeDcdnDomainTopReferVisit查询域名某天的热门页面引用次数排名，支持获取最近90天的数据

DescribeDcdnDomainTopUrlVisit.description_en: Call DescribeDcdnDomainTopUrlVisit to retrieve the top URLs for an accelerated domain name on a specific day
DescribeDcdnDomainTopUrlVisit.description_zh: 调用DescribeDcdnDomainTopUrlVisit获取加速域名某天内的热门URL列表

DescribeDcdnDomainTrafficData.description_en: Queries the network traffic data of accelerated domain names
DescribeDcdnDomainTrafficData.description_zh: 调用DescribeDcdnDomainTrafficData查询域名的网络流量监控数据

DescribeDcdnDomainUsageData.description_en: Call the DescribeDcdnDomainUsageData operation to query the usage data of a domain name in a specific billing region
DescribeDcdnDomainUsageData.description_zh: 调用DescribeDcdnDomainUsageData查询域名在特定计费区域的用量数据

DescribeDcdnDomainUvData.description_en: Call DescribeDcdnDomainUvData to obtain statistics about unique visitors (UVs) for accelerated domain names at a 1-hour granularity. You can query data from the last 90 days
DescribeDcdnDomainUvData.description_zh: 调用DescribeDcdnDomainUvData获取加速域名1小时粒度的UV页面独立访问统计，支持获取最近90天的数据

DescribeDcdnDomainWebsocketBpsData.description_zh: 调用DescribeDcdnDomainWebsocketBpsData查询域名WebSocket协议的网络带宽监控数据

DescribeDcdnDomainWebsocketTrafficData.description_zh: 调用DescribeDcdnDomainWebsocketTrafficData查询域名的WebSocket网络流量监控数据

DescribeDcdnFullDomainsBlockIPConfig.description_zh: 调用DescribeDcdnFullDomainsBlockIPConfig查询全量封禁的相关配置

DescribeDcdnHttpsDomainList.description_zh: 调用DescribeDcdnHttpsDomainList查询用户所有证书信息

DescribeDcdnIpInfo.description_zh: 调用DescribeDcdnIpInfo验证指定的IP是否为阿里云DCDN节点的IP地址

此API需要申请访问权限，如需使用请提交工单

RollbackDcdnStagingConfig.description_en: Rolls back the staging Dynamic Content Delivery Network (DCDN) configuration to the production version

SetDcdnDomainSSLCertificate.description_zh: 调用SetDcdnDomainSSLCertificate设置某域名下是否启用证书功能及更新证书信息

SetDcdnDomainStagingConfig.description_zh: 调用SetDcdnDomainStagingConfig设置或修改域名配置（灰度）

SetDcdnFullDomainsBlockIP.description_en: Call the SetDcdnFullDomainsBlockIP operation to block or unblock specified IP addresses or CIDR blocks
SetDcdnFullDomainsBlockIP.description_zh: 调用SetDcdnFullDomainsBlockIP可以对指定的IP或IP段，进行封禁解禁操作

SetDcdnUserConfig.description_en: Call SetDcdnUserConfig to configure user settings
SetDcdnUserConfig.description_zh: 调用SetDcdnUserConfig设置用户的配置信息

StartDcdnDomain.description_en: Call StartDcdnDomain to enable a disabled accelerated domain name. This operation changes the DomainStatus to online
StartDcdnDomain.description_zh: 调用StartDcdnDomain启用状态为停用的加速域名，将DomainStatus变更为online

StartDcdnIpaDomain.description_zh: 调用StartDcdnIpaDomain启用状态为停用的加速域名，将DomainStatus变更为online

StopDcdnDomain.description_en: Call StopDcdnDomain to disable an accelerated domain name and change its DomainStatus to offline
StopDcdnDomain.description_zh: 调用StopDcdnDomain停用某个加速域名，将DomainStatus变更为offline

StopDcdnIpaDomain.description_en: Call StopDcdnIpaDomain to disable an accelerated domain name. This operation sets the domain's status to offline
StopDcdnIpaDomain.description_zh: 调用StopDcdnIpaDomain停用某个加速域名，将DomainStatus变更为offline
